note: Checksums are SHA-256 of the file bytes. Raw downloads belong in data/boundaries/incoming/ and are gitignored. CI uses tests/fixtures/boundaries/ and does not download these files. geoBoundaries CGAZ GeoJSON objects are Git LFS on GitHub; the sha256 values are the LFS object ids of those file bytes. GADM is not a source.
